title: 第234章  算计
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

既然弃井印借井心之力，那就切它与井心之间的路。

宋青山抬手按住眉心。

守井印的金光没有继续外放，反而一点点收束，凝成一枚极细的金色印纹。

那印纹悬在他眉心前，如一枚小小的烈日钉。

沈冰心立刻看出了他的意图。

“你要用神识入印？”

宋青山点头。

“弃井印和井心之间有一根线。”

“斩了它。”

沈冰心脸色微变。

“太危险。”

“你的神识若被井心里的东西咬住，会比肉身受伤更麻烦。”

宋青山看着黑先生。

“没时间换方法。”

黑先生似乎听见了他们的对话。

他微微偏头，声音仍旧平静。

“以神识斩印线。”

“很聪明。”

“但你确定要把自己的神识送到井心边缘？”

宋青山淡淡道：“你话越多，说明这招越有用。”

黑先生轻笑一声。

“也许。”

话音落下，他抬手一按。

倒井山坳中央的黑洞骤然扩张。

原本一丈见方的洞口，此刻裂开至两丈，边缘黑土不断塌陷。

洞下那座石门变得更加清晰。

门后，暗红眼睛贴着门缝。

像某种巨大的生灵，正在从千年黑暗里醒来。

一缕缕灾厄气息，从门缝中渗出。

不是普通阴气。

它更古怪。

更混乱。

像腐烂的星光，又像烧焦的梦。

沈冰心只是看了一眼，便觉得心口发闷。

她立刻取出清神丸含在舌下，又把一枚塞进宋青山手中。

“含着。”

宋青山照做。

这一次，他没有嫌苦。

因为那股灾厄气息确实可怕。

它不是简单伤人。

而是在污染人的认知。

让人觉得眼前的黑暗是正常的，让人觉得毁灭是归宿，让人觉得

这才是封魂井真正镇压的东西。

尸傀、尸虫、血蛊、聂天衡尸壳，都只是它外泄后的附属污秽。

黑先生站在洞口边缘，胸前弃井印黑光流转。

他像一名站在深渊旁的祭司。

“宋青山。”

“你现在后退，还来得及。”

宋青山道：“你要是现在跳进去，我也可以不追。”

黑先生：“……”

沈冰心原本紧绷的心神，竟被这句话拉回一线清明。

她忍不住看了宋青山一眼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Since the abandoned well seal borrows the power of the well center, then cut the road between it and the well center.

Song Qingshan raised his hand and pressed it between his eyebrows.

The golden light of the Shoujing Seal did not continue to shine out, but instead shrank little by little, condensing into an extremely fine golden seal.

The mark hung in front of his eyebrows, like a small scorching sun nail.

Shen Bingxin immediately saw his intention.

"You want to use your spiritual consciousness to enter the seal?"

Song Qingshan nodded.

"There is a line between the mark of the abandoned well and the center of the well."

"Cut it off."

Shen Bingxin's expression changed slightly.

"Too dangerous."

"If your consciousness is bitten by something in the well, it will be more troublesome than being physically injured."

Song Qingshan looked at Mr. Hei.

"There's no time to try another method."

Mr. Black seemed to have heard their conversation.

He tilted his head slightly, his voice still calm.

"Use your spiritual consciousness to cut the seal line."

"Very smart."

"But are you sure you want to send your consciousness to the edge of the well?"

Song Qingshan said calmly: "The more you talk, the more effective this trick will be."

Mr. Black chuckled.

"Maybe."

After the words fell, he raised his hand and pressed it.

The black hole in the center of Daojing Mountain Col suddenly expanded.

The opening of the cave, which was originally one foot square, now cracked to two feet, and the black soil around the edge continued to collapse.

The stone door under the cave became clearer.

Behind the door, dark red eyes were pressed against the crack of the door.

Like some huge creature, waking up from the thousand-year darkness.

Wisps of misfortune seeped out from the cracks in the door.

This is not ordinary Yin Qi.

It's weirder.

More chaos.

Like rotten starlight, like a burnt dream.

Shen Bingxin just glanced at it and felt stuffy in her heart.

She immediately took out the Qingshen pill and held it under her tongue, then put another one into Song Qingshan's hand.

"Hold it."

Song Qingshan did as he was told.

This time, he didn't find it hard.

Because that aura of disaster is truly terrifying.

It's not simply hurtful.

Rather, it is polluting people’s cognition.

It makes people feel that the darkness in front of them is normal, makes people feel that destruction is the destination, and makes people feel that

This is what the Soul Seal Well can truly suppress.

Corpse puppets, corpse worms, blood Gu, and Nie Tianheng's corpse shell are just the filth attached to it after it is leaked.

Mr. Hei stood on the edge of the cave entrance, with the black light flowing from the abandoned well mark on his chest.

He is like a priest standing by the abyss.

"Song Qingshan."

"It's still too late if you step back now."

Song Qingshan said: "If you jump in now, I don't have to chase you."

Mr. Black: "..."

Shen Bingxin's originally tense mind was brought back to clarity by these words.

She couldn't help but glance at Song Qingshan.
